message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel t-SNE scatter plot comparing A-mem and Base embedding distributions in two dialogues.","description":"Two side-by-side scatter plots show individual points, with no lines connecting them. In both panels the horizontal and vertical axes have numeric ticks but no axis titles; the legend identifies A-mem as blue and Base as coral. Panel (a), “Dialogue 1,” has x ticks from about −20 to 20 and y ticks from −20 to 20. Blue points form several discernible concentrations, including a large lower-central group around x −6 to 2 and y −12 to −3, an upper group around x −5 to 3 and y 8 to 14, and smaller groups near (8, 20) and (15, 10). Coral points are more broadly dispersed across the plotting area, overlapping the blue groups. Panel (b), “Dialogue 2,” has x ticks from about −20 to 20 and y ticks from −20 to 30. Blue points show prominent concentrations near x −2 to 5, y 16 to 23 and x −10 to 4, y −19 to −9, with other blue points scattered around the center. Coral points are spread more broadly across the panel and overlap these concentrations.
